headline: Jatrabari shooting: Man killed, another injured in Dhaka
summary: Assailants on motorcycles fired indiscriminately at two men sitting outside a rickshaw garage in Dhalpur.
details: A 40-year-old man was killed and another injured after assailants opened fire in Dhaka’s Jatrabari on Sunday night. The incident took place around 11:00 pm in Dhalpur Sardar Goli.
caption:

headline_marked: 4 suspects [[arrested for killing Special Branch SI]] in Savar
headline: 4 suspects arrested for killing Special Branch SI in Savar
summary: RAB has apprehended four named suspects from Munshiganj after a police officer was beaten to death in his sons' garment factory.
details: RAB has arrested four named suspects from Munshiganj in connection with the murder of Special Branch (SB) Sub-Inspector (SI) Md. Altab Hossain in Savar.
The incident occurred on Saturday night in the Bodeshi area of Aminbazar, Savar, where the SI was beaten to death inside his sons' garment factory.
According to the family, the attack began after SI Altab attempted to stop a group of people in a private car from beating an elderly man near an auto-rickshaw garage.
When the attack shifted to the officer, he identified himself as a police member, but the assailants continued to attack him and his younger son, Ariful Islam, who was seriously injured.
The attackers, numbering between 20 to 25 people, allegedly forced their way into the garment factory, where they assaulted the father and son with indigenous weapons.
SI Altab was declared dead upon arrival at Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College Hospital, while his son remains hospitalized for treatment.
The victim's eldest son, Shariful Islam, alleged that a group of people in a white private car frequently loitered near the factory and used the nearby area for drug use.
Police had previously arrested one person in connection with the case filed by the the victim's wife.
caption:
A Special Branch SI was beaten to death after trying to stop a group of people from assaulting an elderly man.

RAB has arrested four named suspects from Munshiganj in connection with the murder of Special Branch (SB) Sub-Inspector (SI) Md. Altab Hossain in Savar.

The incident occurred on Saturday night in the Bodeshi area of Aminbazar, Savar, where the SI was beaten to death inside his sons' garment factory.

According to the family, the attack began after SI Altab attempted to stop a group of people in a private car from beating an elderly man near an auto-rickshaw garage.

When the attack shifted to the officer, he identified himself as a police member, but the assailants continued to attack him and his younger son, Ariful Islam, who was seriously injured.

The attackers, numbering between 20 to 25 people, allegedly forced their way into the garment factory, where they assaulted the father and son with indigenous weapons.

SI Altab was declared dead upon arrival at Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College Hospital, while his son remains hospitalized for treatment.

The victim's eldest son, Shariful Islam, alleged that a group of people in a white private car frequently loitered near the factory and used the nearby area for drug use.

Police had previously arrested one person in connection with the case filed by the the victim's wife.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Prothom Alo, The Daily Star
